semantics.selection: Restart the 0,2,4,... near-record selection in each cell; preserve old Far start/lo/hi from original JS lists.
semantics.range: Explicit [nearStart*36, nearCellCount*36] vertex range, firstInstance=0; (ceil(N/2)-1)*72+36 <= N*36, including final odd cell.
semantics.width: Baseline writes width into Float32Array before *=1.5: f32(f32(originalWidth)*1.5). Candidate CPU reconstruction follows the same order exactly; GPU shader execution remains to be checked.
semantics.draws: One draw and one vertex-buffer binding per nonempty visible far cell. Counts below use recorded real bounds/cameras; actual counts do not affect number of calls when cell occupancy stays the same.
semantics.qaOnly: sharedFarQA recreates old Far and near arrays temporarily; exclude it from shipping and timing builds.

limits: Culling uses recorded real bounds and cameras with artificial per-cell counts.
Full actual-world record proof is exported as sharedFarQA; requires builder/browser execution.
API buffer payload reductions are not process RSS/peak measurements.
